ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 66
   D. 17

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

6. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 4

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 90

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
